source.author: R. P. Bielat
source.note: UNT Digital Library copy: a different scan from the NTRS file (35 pages, 1-bit images, PDF 1.3). Used only as an independent check of the NTRS digitization.

figure.title: Variation with lift coefficient of the aerodynamic characteristics for the 35 deg sweptback wing. (b) Drag coefficient.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, CL (staggered: each Mach number has its own CL = 0, marked by a 0 label on the bottom row)
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, CD (common to all Mach numbers)
figure.content_note: Measured points: hollow symbols with a centre dot, joined by faired curves. Bitonal scan.

scan.extraction: tools/digitize/extract_scan.py on the UNT PDF: the page's single embedded 1-bit image, page /Rotate 0

digitizer: main session, UNT scan (independent scan, same reader as pass A)

calibration.x_definition: Same staggered common axis as the NTRS specs: leftmost frame line -0.2, grid every 0.1, M 0.90 zero at 0.6.

series.omitted: p2, p3, p6, p7, p9, p10: in this 1-bit scan the centre dot merges with the faired curve or a grid line, so no isolated dot exists; reading those centres by eye was judged not cheap (brief 001, Amendment 2, point 5) and is listed in Tickets.
